title: Reconnaissance selects RED Beach 2
placementNote: Pre-July predecessor/background material; chapter coverage must be deliberately decided before publication.

paragraphs.text: 1st Force Reconnaissance Subunit 1 and UDT 12 reconnoitered RED Beaches 1 and 2 from USS Cook. RED Beach 2 was selected for BLT 3/9. This was supporting-unit activity, not a 3/9 patrol.

notes: Source references support the whole proposal; normalized OCR is not a human correction.
